standard_prerequisites.name: Sections of a quasi-coherent algebra
standard_prerequisites.use: R tensor_{R-prime} A-prime to A is an isomorphism.

standard_prerequisites.name: Fibre products of affines
standard_prerequisites.use: Spec of a tensor product is the fibre product of the spectra.

core_obligations: A = A(U) is R tensor_{R-prime} A-prime by quasi-coherence of the algebra sheaf.
Hence Spec(A) = Spec(R) x_{Spec(R-prime)} Spec(A-prime), which is exactly the displayed cartesian square over U to U-prime.
proof_roadmap: Identify the section algebra as the base-changed tensor product, then read the square off the affine fibre product.
difficulty_reason: Quasi-coherence gives the tensor identification of the section algebra; the cartesian square is read off the affine fibre product; fully displayed.
